Recognize the approach

Skeuomorphic interfaces reference familiar objects or materials to communicate use.

Look for

  • Recognizable physical materials
  • Controls with apparent depth
  • Object metaphors tied to function

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Skeuomorphic interfaces reference familiar objects or materials to communicate use. A leather-bound notebook or physical-looking switch is more specific than a button that merely has a shadow.

Period or influence

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Draw or render the material, frame, and control states separately.
  2. Keep controls as real HTML elements over the artwork. Use consistent lighting and make the pressed state physically plausible.

Small practice task

Design an original wooden control panel with one blue button. Show its normal, focused, and pressed states.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
